messages:
Priya Nair: quick note — spotted two mismatches in the /v1/generate docs during a review. The spec shows `timeout` as a string and examples use `generation` (singular). The running service requires `timeout_ms` (integer) and returns `generations` (array).

Tomás Ruiz: thanks. can you paste the failing curl?

Priya Nair: repro: `curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?timeout=5000\" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hello"}'` -> 400 `invalid type for timeout`. Server accepts `timeout_ms=5000` or header `X-Timeout-Ms: 5000`.

Ben Holloway: confirmed in staging. we made this change server-side (rename + removed string coercion) to avoid ambiguity. docs need: (1) OpenAPI param rename to `timeout_ms` integer, (2) update examples to show `generations` array, (3) short migration note, (4) SDK mapping note (JS uses `timeoutMs`).

Priya Nair: suggested YAML snippet for the OpenAPI param:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: timeout_ms
    in: query
    schema:
      type: integer
      format: int32
      example: 5000
```
And sample response to replace the singular generation example:
```json
{
  "id": "req_abc123",
  "model": "rwd-13b",
  "generations": [
    {"text": "hello", "tokens": ["hello"], "metadata": {}}
  ],
  "perf": {"latency_ms": 32}
}
```

Tomás Ruiz: small style nit: in the API ref examples we prefer double-quoted field names in JSON blocks and an explicit `examples:` anchor in OpenAPI. Also add a one-line mapping in migration docs: HTTP `timeout_ms` -> JS `timeoutMs`.

Ben Holloway: I'll open the PR to update openapi/specs/generate.yaml, docs/examples/generate.md, docs/migrations/2026-03-generate-timeoutms-and-generations.md, and docs/CHANGELOG.md. Will also add a quick infra smoke test that asserts `generations` is present to catch regressions.

Priya Nair: thanks — please tag me for review.

Ben Holloway: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/4772 (labels: docs, breaking-change, needs-review). Assigning @Priya Nair @Tomás Ruiz.

docs-bot: PR opened by Ben Holloway: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/4772 (labels: docs, breaking-change, needs-review).

Tomás Ruiz: i'll review the OpenAPI change and examples.

Priya Nair: will check the migration note and SDK snippet mapping after the PR lands. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
